# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_SQUEEZE_BREAKOUT_WITH_VOLUME_SPIKE

## Hypothesis

A narrowing EMA‑ribbon (squeeze) followed by an expansion accompanied by a volume spike signals a breakout in the direction of the expansion. This captures momentum bursts after low-volatility consolidation, distinct from Bollinger-based squeezes by using EMA ribbon width and requiring volume confirmation.

## Mechanism

Define ribbon width = |EMA9 − EMA21|. When the ribbon width over the last three bars is in the lowest 10% of its values over the past 20 bars (squeeze) and the current bar’s ribbon width expands >20% from that minimum while volume >1.5× the 20‑bar average volume, go long if close > EMA9 or short if close < EMA21. Exit: chart‑stop at opposite side of squeeze (prior low for long, prior high for short), TP1 at 2.0R, runner trailed using premium‑stop of 10% of ATR. Regime hint: effective in medium‑volatility (VIX 15‑25) and 09:45‑11:30 EST; avoid major economic releases.
